experience.persona: A Creator, Player or owner exploring local hand interaction with an ordinary webcam
experience.objective: Enable a camera, see honest tracking, calibrate and independently check pointing, practice, recover and return naturally
experience.visibleOutcome: A coherent staged camera and pointing workspace with visible acquisition, distinct recognition stages, safe recovery and independent results
experience.accessibility: Keyboard, touch and ordinary buttons operate setup, pause, retry, deletion, export and return. The setup request remains operable by keyboard and touch; activation checks current readiness, either opens setup under the existing guards or keeps preparation visible with polite live guidance, and never queues an automatic start. A disclosed guided demo explains the full flow without a camera.
experience.fallback: Camera failure gives a plain-language explanation, retry and a guided conventional demonstration. All Voyagewright navigation remains conventional.
experience.navigation: Existing device connections link opens Reach; the visible return clears owned camera resources and restores device connections; safe contextual return is accepted.
experience.designTarget: One continuous instrument workspace with a large registered camera stage, restrained brass and sea-green hierarchy, staged target plane, contextual guidance, visible progress and deliberately disclosed diagnostics. Mobile preparation prioritizes the camera and calibration prioritizes the target.

limitations: D0 and photographic D1 replay do not establish real-person webcam accuracy, field ergonomics or owner acceptance.
Absolute empirical RGB pointing is experimental and must pass held-out validation for the current setup; relative cursor control has distinct setup and claims.

Phase 2 target selection, Phase 3 manipulation and Crossdeck Air Handoff are not implemented by this laboratory.
